name: ambulance
description: A modern European box ambulance: a van cab with a sloping bonnet, raked windscreen, glazed doors, mirrors, wheel arch trims and an interior with seats, dash and steering wheel; behind it a wider and taller patient compartment with a peak over the cab carrying a light bar, blue corner beacons and side flashers, battenburg checks or a red stripe, frosted windows, side lockers, a sliding side door, rear doors hinged at the outer edges, tall rear light clusters, a rear step and grab rails; underneath a ladder chassis, axles, fuel tank and exhaust, on steel van wheels, twin at the rear.

params.name: length
params.description: Length of the patient compartment (the box) in metres; the cab adds about 2 m.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the box; the cab is 0.28 m narrower.

params.name: height
params.description: Roof height of the box above the ground.

params.name: wheelRadius
params.description: Tyre radius (a 16 inch van tyre is about 0.355 m).

params.name: dualRear
params.description: Twin rear wheels (a 5 t chassis) instead of single ones.

params.name: livery
params.description: 0 = battenburg checks in green, 1 = battenburg checks in blue, 2 = a red stripe.

params.name: lightBar
params.description: A light bar on the peak over the cab (the corner beacons are always there).

params.name: roofUnit
params.description: An air-conditioning unit on the roof.

params.name: sideDoor
params.description: A sliding door into the patient compartment on the right side (-x); without it the side has a window.
